data.name: Rihaan
data.gender_notes: Rihaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who travels, wanders, or explores. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'riha' which means 'to wander'. The name Rihaan carries the meaning “Traveler, wanderer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rihaan usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler, wanderer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages exploration and learning, promotes inner growth and self-discovery.
data.etymology: Rihaan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler, wanderer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rihaan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
